guarantees.claim: If u_sha3.u_pad.u_sentmsg_count has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If u_sha3.u_keccak.u_round_count has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If u_kmac_core.u_key_index_count has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_kmac_core.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_app_intf.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_sha3.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_sha3.u_pad.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_sha3.u_keccak.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_errchk.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the sparse FSM state registers in u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If EnMasking is 1 and the sparse FSM state registers in gen_entropy.u_entropy.u_state_regs indicate an invalid state, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If EnMasking is 1 and gen_entropy.u_entropy.u_hash_count has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If EnMasking is 1 and u_msgfifo.u_packer.g_pos_dupcnt.u_pos has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If EnMasking is 1 and the secure write pointer counter in u_msgfifo has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If EnMasking is 1 and the secure read pointer counter in u_msgfifo has a count error, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.
If the write enables in u_reg are not one-hot, alert_tx_o[1] is asserted.

assumptions.claim: When reg2hw.cmd.cmd.qe is asserted, reg2hw.cmd.cmd.q must be one of the sparse values: CmdStart, CmdProcess, CmdManualRun, CmdDone, CmdNone.
assumptions.risk: If violated, formal proofs based on this assumption are invalidated; the design may exhibit undefined behavior with an illegal command value.

uncertain_points.claim: The design relies on the assumption that the command is sparse (CmdSparse_M) only for formal verification; there is no hardware assertion or alert that triggers if the command field is illegal at runtime.
uncertain_points.cond: A non-sparse command value is applied while cmd.qe is high.
uncertain_points.risk: An illegal command may cause unguarded state transitions, corrupt internal state, or bypass security checks, potentially leading to information leakage or incorrect operation.

uncertain_points.claim: The assertion instances inside the `if (EnMasking == 1)` block assume specific internal module hierarchies (e.g., u_msgfifo.u_packer.g_pos_dupcnt) are present. If other parameterizations or generate conditions alter these hierarchies while EnMasking remains 1, the assertions may not bind or may refer to non-existent signals.
uncertain_points.cond: EnMasking == 1 but internal structure differs due to other parameters.
uncertain_points.risk: Count and FSM errors in those submodules could go undetected because the assertions are disabled or invalid.
